content: Supabase is suitable for the v1 backend: supabase-js 2.112.4 plus supabase-ssr 0.12.4 implements cookie sessions for Next SSR, while Postgres RLS scopes organization rows and public campaign reads. Free includes 500 MB, 50k MAU and pauses after 7 inactive days, so state the wake-up and paid-scale trigger explicitly.
